title: Topological fibres of relative affine space are connected
statement: Let $S$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $d\geq0$, and let $p:\mathbf A^d_S\to S$ be the projection [def-sbc-affine-space]. For every point $s\in|S|$, the subset $|p|^{-1}(\{s\})$ of $|\mathbf A^d_S|$, with its subspace topology, is nonempty and connected [def-weil-connected-scheme]. No Noetherian, nonemptiness, or finiteness hypothesis is imposed on $S$.
